```{r }
#| label: median-mad-bootstrap
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-align: center

# ============================================================
# Conventional Bootstrap Median-MAD Control Charts
# Each Excel workbook must contain three worksheets:
#   DAR
#   CAR
#   Mic
#
# Each worksheet must contain:
#   Event
#   Result
#
# For each worksheet:
#   Top panel    = Median chart
#   Bottom panel = MAD chart
#
# All events in each worksheet are used for bootstrap
# calibration. No Phase I or Phase II separation is used.
#
# Each chart has its own bootstrap CL and UCL.
# No LCL is calculated.
# Only points above the UCL are classified as OOC.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# 1. Packages
# ============================================================

required_packages <- c(
  "readxl",
  "dplyr",
  "ggplot2",
  "patchwork"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(
    required_packages,
    requireNamespace,
    quietly = TRUE,
    FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
  )
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Install the following packages before rendering: ",
      paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)


# ============================================================
# 2. median_mad() function
# ============================================================

median_mad <- function(
    file,
    equipment_name,
    sheets = c("DAR", "CAR", "Mic"),
    event_col = "Event",
    result_col = "Result",
    B = 10000,
    alpha = 0.0027,
    seed = 2026,
    max_x_labels = 15
) {

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.1 Input checks
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Excel file not found: ",
        file
      )
    )
  }

  if (B < 1000) {
    warning(
      "B is less than 1000. At least 10000 replicates are recommended."
    )
  }

  if (alpha <= 0 || alpha >= 1) {
    stop("alpha must be between 0 and 1.")
  }

  if (max_x_labels < 2) {
    stop("max_x_labels must be at least 2.")
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.2 Normalize worksheet and column names
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  normalize_text <- function(x) {

    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", x)
    x <- tolower(x)

    x
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.3 Find a worksheet
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  find_sheet <- function(requested_sheet) {

    available_sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(file)

    matched_position <- which(
      normalize_text(available_sheets) ==
        normalize_text(requested_sheet)
    )

    if (length(matched_position) == 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Worksheet '",
          requested_sheet,
          "' was not found in ",
          basename(file),
          ". Available worksheets: ",
          paste(available_sheets, collapse = ", ")
        )
      )
    }

    available_sheets[matched_position[1]]
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.4 Find a column
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  find_column <- function(data, requested_column) {

    available_columns <- names(data)

    matched_position <- which(
      normalize_text(available_columns) ==
        normalize_text(requested_column)
    )

    if (length(matched_position) == 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Column '",
          requested_column,
          "' was not found. Available columns: ",
          paste(available_columns, collapse = ", ")
        )
      )
    }

    available_columns[matched_position[1]]
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.5 Read one worksheet
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  read_sheet_data <- function(sheet_name) {

    actual_sheet <- find_sheet(
      requested_sheet = sheet_name
    )

    raw_data <- readxl::read_excel(
      path = file,
      sheet = actual_sheet
    )

    if (nrow(raw_data) == 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Worksheet '",
          actual_sheet,
          "' in ",
          basename(file),
          " is empty."
        )
      )
    }

    actual_event_column <- find_column(
      data = raw_data,
      requested_column = event_col
    )

    actual_result_column <- find_column(
      data = raw_data,
      requested_column = result_col
    )

    standardized_data <- raw_data %>%
      transmute(
        Equipment = equipment_name,
        Residue_Type = sheet_name,
        Event = trimws(
          as.character(
            .data[[actual_event_column]]
          )
        ),
        Result = suppressWarnings(
          as.numeric(
            .data[[actual_result_column]]
          )
        )
      ) %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(Event),
        Event != "",
        is.finite(Result)
      )

    if (nrow(standardized_data) == 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "No usable numerical results were found in worksheet '",
          actual_sheet,
          "' of ",
          basename(file),
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    standardized_data
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.6 Calculate event-level median and MAD
  #
  # MAD is unscaled:
  # median(abs(x - median(x)))
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  calculate_event_statistics <- function(data) {

    event_order <- unique(data$Event)

    event_statistics <- data %>%
      mutate(
        Event = factor(
          Event,
          levels = event_order
        )
      ) %>%
      group_by(
        Equipment,
        Residue_Type,
        Event
      ) %>%
      summarise(
        n = sum(
          is.finite(Result)
        ),
        Median = median(
          Result,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        MAD = median(
          abs(
            Result -
              median(Result, na.rm = TRUE)
          ),
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(Event) %>%
      mutate(
        Event = as.character(Event),
        Event_Index = row_number()
      )

    event_statistics
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.7 Calculate bootstrap CLs and UCLs
  #
  # All observations in the current worksheet are pooled.
  #
  # A separate bootstrap distribution is generated for every
  # cleaning-event sample size n observed in the worksheet.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  calculate_bootstrap_limits <- function(
      data,
      sheet_seed
  ) {

    pooled_values <- data$Result

    pooled_values <- pooled_values[
      is.finite(pooled_values)
    ]

    if (length(pooled_values) < 2) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          equipment_name,
          ": at least two finite observations are required."
        )
      )
    }

    event_statistics <- calculate_event_statistics(
      data = data
    )

    sample_sizes <- sort(
      unique(event_statistics$n)
    )

    set.seed(sheet_seed)

    limit_list <- lapply(
      sample_sizes,
      function(current_n) {

        bootstrap_statistics <- replicate(
          B,
          {
            bootstrap_sample <- sample(
              pooled_values,
              size = current_n,
              replace = TRUE
            )

            bootstrap_median <- median(
              bootstrap_sample,
              na.rm = TRUE
            )

            bootstrap_mad <- median(
              abs(
                bootstrap_sample -
                  bootstrap_median
              ),
              na.rm = TRUE
            )

            c(
              Median = bootstrap_median,
              MAD = bootstrap_mad
            )
          }
        )

        data.frame(
          n = current_n,

          Median_CL = median(
            bootstrap_statistics["Median", ],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),

          Median_UCL = unname(
            quantile(
              bootstrap_statistics["Median", ],
              probs = 1 - alpha,
              type = 8,
              na.rm = TRUE
            )
          ),

          MAD_CL = median(
            bootstrap_statistics["MAD", ],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),

          MAD_UCL = unname(
            quantile(
              bootstrap_statistics["MAD", ],
              probs = 1 - alpha,
              type = 8,
              na.rm = TRUE
            )
          )
        )
      }
    )

    bootstrap_limits <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      limit_list
    )

    bootstrap_limits
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.8 Prepare chart data and identify OOC events
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  prepare_chart_data <- function(
      data,
      sheet_seed
  ) {

    event_statistics <- calculate_event_statistics(
      data = data
    )

    bootstrap_limits <- calculate_bootstrap_limits(
      data = data,
      sheet_seed = sheet_seed
    )

    chart_data <- event_statistics %>%
      left_join(
        bootstrap_limits,
        by = "n"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Median_Status = if_else(
          Median > Median_UCL,
          "OOC",
          "In Control"
        ),

        MAD_Status = if_else(
          MAD > MAD_UCL,
          "OOC",
          "In Control"
        ),

        Median_Amount_Above_UCL =
          Median - Median_UCL,

        MAD_Amount_Above_UCL =
          MAD - MAD_UCL
      )

    missing_limits <- (
      any(is.na(chart_data$Median_CL)) ||
        any(is.na(chart_data$Median_UCL)) ||
        any(is.na(chart_data$MAD_CL)) ||
        any(is.na(chart_data$MAD_UCL))
    )

    if (missing_limits) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          equipment_name,
          ": at least one event could not be matched ",
          "to its bootstrap control limits."
        )
      )
    }

    list(
      Chart_Data = chart_data,
      Bootstrap_Limits = bootstrap_limits
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.9 Select readable x-axis labels
  #
  # All cleaning events remain in the chart.
  # Only selected event names are printed.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  get_x_axis <- function(chart_data) {

    number_of_events <- nrow(chart_data)

    if (number_of_events == 0) {
      stop("No cleaning events are available for plotting.")
    }

    if (number_of_events <= max_x_labels) {

      break_positions <- chart_data$Event_Index

    } else {

      break_positions <- unique(
        round(
          seq(
            from = 1,
            to = number_of_events,
            length.out = max_x_labels
          )
        )
      )
    }

    matched_positions <- match(
      break_positions,
      chart_data$Event_Index
    )

    break_labels <- chart_data$Event[
      matched_positions
    ]

    list(
      breaks = break_positions,
      labels = break_labels
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.10 Create median chart
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  create_median_chart <- function(
      chart_data,
      residue_type
  ) {

    x_axis <- get_x_axis(
      chart_data = chart_data
    )

    median_chart <- ggplot(
      chart_data,
      aes(
        x = Event_Index,
        y = Median
      )
    ) +
      geom_line(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.40
      ) +
      geom_point(
        aes(color = Median_Status),
        size = 2.5
      ) +
      geom_line(
        aes(y = Median_CL),
        color = "darkgreen",
        linewidth = 0.75
      ) +
      geom_line(
        aes(y = Median_UCL),
        color = "red",
        linewidth = 0.80,
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "In Control" = "black",
          "OOC" = "red"
        ),
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = x_axis$breaks,
        labels = x_axis$labels,
        expand = expansion(
          mult = c(0.01, 0.02)
        )
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(
          equipment_name,
          ": ",
          residue_type,
          " Median Chart"
        ),
        x = NULL,
        y = "Median",
        color = NULL
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(
          face = "bold",
          size = 12
        ),
        axis.title.y = element_text(
          size = 11
        ),
        axis.text.y = element_text(
          size = 9
        ),
        plot.margin = margin(
          t = 5,
          r = 10,
          b = 2,
          l = 5
        )
      )

    median_chart
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.11 Create MAD chart
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  create_mad_chart <- function(
      chart_data,
      residue_type
  ) {

    x_axis <- get_x_axis(
      chart_data = chart_data
    )

    mad_chart <- ggplot(
      chart_data,
      aes(
        x = Event_Index,
        y = MAD
      )
    ) +
      geom_line(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.40
      ) +
      geom_point(
        aes(color = MAD_Status),
        size = 2.5
      ) +
      geom_line(
        aes(y = MAD_CL),
        color = "darkgreen",
        linewidth = 0.75
      ) +
      geom_line(
        aes(y = MAD_UCL),
        color = "red",
        linewidth = 0.80,
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "In Control" = "black",
          "OOC" = "red"
        ),
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = x_axis$breaks,
        labels = x_axis$labels,
        expand = expansion(
          mult = c(0.01, 0.02)
        ),
        guide = guide_axis(
          angle = 45,
          check.overlap = TRUE
        )
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(
          equipment_name,
          ": ",
          residue_type,
          " MAD Chart"
        ),
        x = "Cleaning Event",
        y = "MAD",
        color = NULL
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(
          size = 8
        ),
        axis.text.y = element_text(
          size = 9
        ),
        axis.title.x = element_text(
          size = 11,
          margin = margin(t = 10)
        ),
        axis.title.y = element_text(
          size = 11
        ),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(
          face = "bold",
          size = 12
        ),
        plot.margin = margin(
          t = 2,
          r = 10,
          b = 5,
          l = 5
        )
      )

    mad_chart
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.12 Create OOC-event lists
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  create_ooc_lists <- function(
      chart_data,
      residue_type
  ) {

    median_ooc <- chart_data %>%
      filter(
        Median_Status == "OOC"
      ) %>%
      transmute(
        Equipment = equipment_name,
        Residue_Type = residue_type,
        Chart = "Median",
        Event_Index,
        Event,
        n,
        Statistic = Median,
        CL = Median_CL,
        UCL = Median_UCL,
        Amount_Above_UCL =
          Median_Amount_Above_UCL
      )

    mad_ooc <- chart_data %>%
      filter(
        MAD_Status == "OOC"
      ) %>%
      transmute(
        Equipment = equipment_name,
        Residue_Type = residue_type,
        Chart = "MAD",
        Event_Index,
        Event,
        n,
        Statistic = MAD,
        CL = MAD_CL,
        UCL = MAD_UCL,
        Amount_Above_UCL =
          MAD_Amount_Above_UCL
      )

    chart_specific_ooc <- bind_rows(
      median_ooc,
      mad_ooc
    ) %>%
      arrange(
        Event_Index,
        Chart
      )

    unique_ooc <- chart_data %>%
      filter(
        Median_Status == "OOC" |
          MAD_Status == "OOC"
      ) %>%
      transmute(
        Equipment = equipment_name,
        Residue_Type = residue_type,
        Event_Index,
        Event,
        n,

        Median,
        Median_CL,
        Median_UCL,
        Median_OOC =
          Median_Status == "OOC",

        MAD,
        MAD_CL,
        MAD_UCL,
        MAD_OOC =
          MAD_Status == "OOC",

        OOC_Chart = case_when(
          Median_Status == "OOC" &
            MAD_Status == "OOC" ~
            "Median and MAD",

          Median_Status == "OOC" ~
            "Median",

          MAD_Status == "OOC" ~
            "MAD",

          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      ) %>%
      arrange(Event_Index)

    ooc_summary <- data.frame(
      Equipment = equipment_name,
      Residue_Type = residue_type,

      Number_of_Events =
        nrow(chart_data),

      Median_OOC_Events = sum(
        chart_data$Median_Status == "OOC",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      MAD_OOC_Events = sum(
        chart_data$MAD_Status == "OOC",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      Unique_OOC_Events = sum(
        chart_data$Median_Status == "OOC" |
          chart_data$MAD_Status == "OOC",
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )

    list(
      Median_OOC = median_ooc,
      MAD_OOC = mad_ooc,
      Chart_Specific_OOC = chart_specific_ooc,
      Unique_OOC = unique_ooc,
      OOC_Summary = ooc_summary
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.13 Analyze DAR, CAR, and Mic
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  results <- list()

  for (sheet_number in seq_along(sheets)) {

    sheet_name <- sheets[sheet_number]

    sheet_data <- read_sheet_data(
      sheet_name = sheet_name
    )

    sheet_seed <- seed + sheet_number

    analysis <- prepare_chart_data(
      data = sheet_data,
      sheet_seed = sheet_seed
    )

    chart_data <- analysis$Chart_Data

    median_chart <- create_median_chart(
      chart_data = chart_data,
      residue_type = sheet_name
    )

    mad_chart <- create_mad_chart(
      chart_data = chart_data,
      residue_type = sheet_name
    )

    combined_chart <- median_chart / mad_chart +
      patchwork::plot_layout(
        heights = c(1, 1)
      )

    ooc_lists <- create_ooc_lists(
      chart_data = chart_data,
      residue_type = sheet_name
    )

    results[[sheet_name]] <- list(
      Chart = combined_chart,

      Chart_Data =
        chart_data,

      Bootstrap_Limits =
        analysis$Bootstrap_Limits,

      Median_OOC =
        ooc_lists$Median_OOC,

      MAD_OOC =
        ooc_lists$MAD_OOC,

      Chart_Specific_OOC =
        ooc_lists$Chart_Specific_OOC,

      Unique_OOC =
        ooc_lists$Unique_OOC,

      OOC_Summary =
        ooc_lists$OOC_Summary
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.14 Combine OOC results for the equipment
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  all_ooc_summary <- bind_rows(
    lapply(
      sheets,
      function(sheet_name) {
        results[[sheet_name]]$OOC_Summary
      }
    )
  )

  all_unique_ooc <- bind_rows(
    lapply(
      sheets,
      function(sheet_name) {
        results[[sheet_name]]$Unique_OOC
      }
    )
  ) %>%
    arrange(
      Residue_Type,
      Event_Index
    )

  all_chart_specific_ooc <- bind_rows(
    lapply(
      sheets,
      function(sheet_name) {
        results[[sheet_name]]$Chart_Specific_OOC
      }
    )
  ) %>%
    arrange(
      Residue_Type,
      Event_Index,
      Chart
    )

  all_bootstrap_limits <- bind_rows(
    lapply(
      sheets,
      function(sheet_name) {

        results[[sheet_name]]$Bootstrap_Limits %>%
          mutate(
            Equipment = equipment_name,
            Residue_Type = sheet_name,
            .before = 1
          )
      }
    )
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.15 Return results
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  list(
    Equipment = equipment_name,

    DAR = results[["DAR"]],

    CAR = results[["CAR"]],

    Mic = results[["Mic"]],

    OOC_Summary =
      all_ooc_summary,

    Unique_OOC_Events =
      all_unique_ooc,

    Chart_Specific_OOC =
      all_chart_specific_ooc,

    Bootstrap_Limits =
      all_bootstrap_limits
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 3. Run median_mad() for Equipment A using file
# ============================================================

equipment_A_results <- median_mad(
  file = file,
  equipment_name = "Equipment A",
  sheets = c("DAR", "CAR", "Mic"),
  event_col = "Event",
  result_col = "Result",
  B = 10000,
  alpha = 0.0027,
  seed = 2026,
  max_x_labels = 15
)


# ============================================================
# 4. Output Equipment A: three pairs of charts
# ============================================================

print(
  equipment_A_results$DAR$Chart
)

print(
  equipment_A_results$CAR$Chart
)

print(
  equipment_A_results$Mic$Chart
)


# ============================================================
# 5. Output Equipment A: OOC summary and event list
# ============================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  "============================================\n",
  "EQUIPMENT A: OOC COUNT SUMMARY\n",
  "============================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

print(
  as.data.frame(
    equipment_A_results$OOC_Summary
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat(
  "\n",
  "============================================\n",
  "EQUIPMENT A: OOC CLEANING EVENTS\n",
  "============================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

if (
  nrow(
    equipment_A_results$Unique_OOC_Events
  ) == 0
) {

  cat(
    "No OOC cleaning events were identified.\n"
  )

} else {

  print(
    as.data.frame(
      equipment_A_results$Unique_OOC_Events
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

  "\n",

  "EQUIPMENT B: OOC COUNT SUMMARY\n",
  "============================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

print(
  as.data.frame(
    equipment_B_results$OOC_Summary
  ),

cat(
  "\n",
  "============================================\n",
```
